basis.quote: I fell in the kitchen this morning and my right hip hurts badly
basis.interpretation: Patient reports acute hip pain following a fall with significant trauma mechanism in an older adult at risk for fracture.

basis.quote: I can't put any weight on that leg
basis.interpretation: Patient demonstrates inability to bear weight on the affected lower extremity, a key clinical finding that suggests structural injury and requires urgent physical examination and imaging.

output.reason: Acute hip pain with weight-bearing loss after fall requires urgent same-day physical examination, imaging (X-ray at minimum), and fracture assessment.
output.physicalRequirement: Physical examination of the right hip with direct palpation and range-of-motion assessment; plain radiography (hip/pelvis X-rays) to evaluate for fracture or other structural injury.

notice.directive: Arrange an in-person assessment today. Do not wait for an asynchronous reply.
